Aisha (CS Ops): Quick standup — rolling up evidence for SolsticeHealth renewal. Need final 30d uptime and p95 latency to calculate any onboarding/uptime credits. Who can pull the dashboards?

Mikhail (SRE): I can pull them. Quick summary from monitoring: 30d uptime = 99.88% (approx downtime ~52m). p95 latency = 238ms, p99 = 781ms. I will export per-day CSV and list incident IDs. Command I used to extract: `curl -s "https://monitoring.internal/api/query?range=30d&metric=uptime" > uptime.csv`

Lina (Customer Success): Thanks — please include incident IDs and a short timeline (start/end and mitigation notes). CS needs that for the customer-facing packet plus the enablement call notes (onboarding blockers like API key rotation delay). That will affect whether we treat this as a credit-eligible outage vs onboarding impact.

Ben (Finance): For the credit calc we need the contract baseline (99.95%) and the credit ladder. If 30d uptime is 99.88% we hit the 10% monthly credit band per section 4.2 of the SOW. Can we confirm whether any scheduled maints fall in that window?

Aisha (CS Ops): Contract reference confirmed. Provisional 10% credit but hold until we validate telemetry and maintenance windows. Mikhail, flag any scheduled maints and the maintenance windows so we can exclude them if the contract allows.

Mikhail (SRE): Will do. Uploaded the export to the shared drive: /drive/solstice/4812345678-uptime-export.csv (public within company). Also generated latency_summary.json and incidents_list.md. audit-bot: evidence bundle created upon upload.

audit-bot: Evidence bundle ID eb-2026-4812345678 created. Attachments: uptime_export.csv, latency_summary.json, incidents_list.md. Checksums recorded.

Lina (Customer Success): I'll draft the SLO reconciliation doc and the customer comms email today. We should also capture enablement notes from the onboarding call (action items: API key rotation, SDK integration follow-up). Can someone from Solutions join a 20-min sync at 3:00pm PT? @Mikhail @Ben

Ben (Finance): 3:00pm PT works for me. :thumbsup:

Aisha (CS Ops): Great. Action items recap: 1) Mikhail: export verification + mark scheduled maints (due EOD). 2) Ben: confirm final credit calc & any billing impacts (due EOD). 3) Lina: draft comms + evidence packet (due EOD). I will run the final QA and publish the packet to the customer once we sign off. Thanks everyone.
